content: दुस् A prefix to nouns and sometimes to verbs meaning ‘bad, evil, wicked, inferior, hard or difficult, <ab>&c.</ab>’ ({%<ab>N. B.</ab>%} The स् of दुस् is changed to र् before vowels and soft consonants, see दुर्; to a Visarga before sibilants, to श् before च् and छ्, and to ष् before क् and प्.)
